egress.dns: No general resolver egress; approved fixed address mapping with TLS hostname preservation
egress.enforcement: Separate host/VM ingress, forwarding and output default-deny policy; bind actual addresses/interfaces; established return traffic only; block metadata, host gateway, Internet and production routes
egress.management: Separately approved temporary operator channel; no runtime access to management identities

budget_semantics: Operation-wide response body budget, counted before decompression and again after decoding; bound headers separately to 8192 bytes per response. Stop before accepting excess; cleanup uses reserved request/time/byte budget. If cleanup cannot complete, report failure and allow short PIT expiry; no retry.

accounts.postgres_owner: NOLOGIN schema owner; no runtime membership
accounts.postgres_provisioner: Temporary development-only initializer; separated from runtime; exact grants require schema review
accounts.postgres_runtime: Non-superuser, no CREATEDB/CREATEROLE/BYPASSRLS or ownership; only reviewed application privileges; no create tenant/key/integration authority
accounts.indexer_provisioner: Development-only account for index creation/seed data and role setup; absent from runner
accounts.indexer_verifier: Independent exact-source metadata and effective-permission inspector; absent from runner
accounts.indexer_reader: Exact concrete index search plus minimum reviewed PIT lifecycle permissions only; no wildcard grants/write/delete/admin/response; inspect inherited/backend/default grants
